entries.camera: Extreme wide establishing shot from across a moonlit rooftop district, deep depth of field, the climber a tiny figure on a huge sheer wall.
entries.subject: A tiny dark figure, seen from behind and far below the eaves, clings by fingertips to the sheer stone face of a tall noble tower, climbing hand over hand between carved window ledges. A coil of rope hangs from the belt. High above, a single warm window glows, its shutters ajar. Around the tower lies a sleeping city of slanted tiled roofs, chimneys and washing lines under a pale full moon, with one slender cat silhouette on a distant ridge.
entries.accent: moonlit silver-grey stone with a single warm gold window

entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder close shot from behind the investigator, 50mm, the foreground lens crisp and everything beyond it softly blurred.
entries.subject: A figure in a long hooded coat, seen from behind, holds a brass magnifying glass up in front of a dusty study. Through the lens a single detail is revealed in sharp, enlarged clarity: a hairline seam and a tiny hidden latch in a wall of bookshelves, a faint thumbprint smudge on the brass. Outside the lens the room is hazy: an overturned chair, a half-open drawer, a stopped pocket watch on a desk, and one beam of lamplight full of drifting dust.

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, symmetrical, wide lens, the table filling the whole frame.
entries.subject: Looking straight down at a huge round council table covered in dark felt, laid out as a plan of a city. Dozens of small carved wooden pieces stand on it, connected by taut threads of gold, as one pair of gloved hands, cropped at the wrists, slides a single ivory piece forward. Many pieces already lean and tumble in a chain reaction toward that one move. Brass candlesticks and a rolled blank map sit at the table's rim, with pools of candlelight.
entries.accent: deep wine-burgundy felt with ivory pieces

entries.camera: Side-on close-up still life at counter height, 100mm, very shallow depth of field, everything in a clean horizontal composition.
entries.subject: A translucent spectral hand made of crackling blue light drifts across a dark wooden counter, delicately lifting a heavy iron key from a sleeping leather coin purse while a second tiny spark-hand holds the lock of a small treasure chest open. A scatter of gold coins, a candle stub and a folded silk glove lie in the foreground. In the soft background, the dim hall of a vault with rows of locked cabinets. No person is visible.
entries.accent: electric cobalt blue with white sparks

entries.camera: Extreme macro close-up at fist height, 85mm look, very shallow depth of field, the lens slightly below the hand and the glowing blade slashing diagonally across the frame.
entries.subject: A closed fist, cropped at the wrist, in plain dark fingerless gloves, from which a long blade of pure translucent psychic energy has just sprouted between the knuckles. The blade is made of glowing, shifting layers of light with faint trails of luminous dust; concentric ripples spread through the air around it and across a floor of dark stone. In the blurred background, an empty vaulted hall with pillars catching the glow.

entries.camera: Canted (dutch-angle) low-angle action shot from the forest floor, wide lens, frozen at a high shutter speed.
entries.subject: A lean figure in a green-brown hooded cloak, seen from behind and the side with the face hidden by the hood, leaps in a frozen sprint across a deep wooded ravine between two mossy boulders, one leg stretched forward, cloak streaming. Fallen leaves and dust explode off the launch rock. Below, a rushing stream and tall tree trunks; shafts of low sun cut through the canopy and a flock of startled birds scatters upward.

entries.camera: Symmetrical long-lens shot from the far end of a dark corridor, the figure a flat black silhouette framed by a blinding tall doorway.
entries.subject: A hooded silhouette seen from behind stands motionless in the middle of a tall arched doorway of blinding white light at the end of a dark hall, cloak hanging still. One arm hangs loosely at the side holding a slim dagger pointing at the floor, from whose tip a single drop of glowing poison is about to fall. The polished floor mirrors the doorway and the silhouette; along the hall, shut doors and unlit lanterns recede.
entries.accent: stark black and cold white with a single toxic lime-green drop

entries.camera: Low-angle shot from ground level among old grave slabs, wide lens, looking up through drifting fog toward the moon.
entries.subject: A tall, translucent hooded spectre with an empty hood of pale mist and no face rises over a moonlit graveyard of leaning blank stone slabs, one thin arm raised. Around its hand a slow ring of small keepsakes hangs in the air: a ring, a locket, a hair comb, a pocket watch, each trailing a thread of ghostly light. Wisps of fog stream outward in rippling waves, as if a wail were passing through them, bending the withered grass and dead flowers.
entries.accent: ghostly pale teal-white fog with cold grey shadows

entries.camera: Fast side-on tracking shot at ankle height along a ship's rail, wide lens, the background streaked with motion blur.
entries.subject: A swashbuckler seen only from the knees down and from behind, mid-pirouette on the polished rail of a tall ship at full sail, boots perfectly balanced on the narrow wood, long coat tails flaring out in a spiral. One slim rapier in a gloved hand flicks out and cuts a rope in a single flash, and a vast white sail drops open beside the ship. Open sea, gulls and sun glitter on the waves blur below.
entries.accent: bright sunlit sky-blue with white sail canvas

entries.camera: Frontal symmetrical wide shot at floor level, one-point perspective, a low cold light from the ground.
entries.subject: A lone hooded silhouette seen from behind stands at the foot of three vast, black, obsidian thrones arranged in a half-ring on a dark stone dais, each carved with a different looming motif: an iron gauntlet, a grinning skull and a ring of jagged spikes. Rust-red mist crawls across the floor between them and rises as a pale curtain behind. A single dagger stands planted point-down in the stone at the figure's feet. The empty thrones tower above.
entries.accent: pitch black with deep crimson glow and pale bone-white
